summary.tldr: Requires the federal government to develop a national strategy for flood and drought forecasting and report it to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of the Environment, with several other federal ministers, to develop a national strategy on flood and drought forecasting.
Requires consultations with provincial and municipal governments, Indigenous governing bodies, universities, civil society groups, and industry, including the insurance industry.
Requires the strategy to assess national coordination, new investment, and new technology for flood and drought forecasting.
Requires the strategy to look at flood risk modelling and at ways to build a national forecasting service and system across Canada.
Requires the Minister to table the strategy in Parliament within two years, publish it online, and later report on how well the strategy worked.
